snippet.title: Anemoiapolis Chapter 1 Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Soundtrack by JORDANN and 4REST. WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522960/Anemoiapolis_Chapter_1/

Anemoiapolis: Chapter 1 will be available for Windows on February 27. Experience the king of liminal space games in all of its desolate glory.
